verdict.rationale: Sumsub documents a first-party Sandbox mode for testing the integration (app tokens, webhooks, WebSDK) before going live, so the sandbox exists. Nothing in the pack shows how to make it produce specific outcomes deterministically. Manual approve/reject is a separate dashboard control and is not credited here. missing for 10: documented test documents, personas or magic values; deterministic pass/fail/review outcome triggering; coverage of every outcome; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, a sandbox lets me exercise every outcome before going live — documented test documents, personas, or magic values that deterministically produce pass, fail, and review results

citations.quote: Use Sandbox mode to test your integration before going live.
Sandbox lets you access most of the Sumsub functionality so that you can: Set up and test your integration using app tokens, webhooks, and our WebSDK.
